description: This Java source file defines the main entry point for the MkStubs tool, including argument parsing, filtering, source code generation, and stubjar creation for Android development purposes.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main class for the MkStubs tool, responsible for command line processing, configuration handling, and orchestrating source and stub jar generation.

classes.name: Main.Params
classes.description: Inner static class encapsulating input parameters such as input/output paths, filter settings, verbose mode, and source dump mode.

classes.name: Main.Logger
classes.description: Inner static class responsible for logging messages; writes debug info only in verbose mode, while info messages are always printed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Static main method that initializes processing, parses arguments, and triggers the build process.

methods.name: processArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, populates Params object, and handles options and patterns.

methods.name: addString
methods.description: Adds filter patterns (include/exclude) or patterns from files into the Params object's filter.

methods.name: addStringsFromFile
methods.description: Reads patterns line-by-line from a file and adds them to the filter.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits when invalid arguments are provided or help is requested.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing method: reads classes from input jar, filters them, optionally generates source code, and creates stub jar.
